_channel_note: Kids Rhyming Channel — nursery rhymes, counting songs, ABC, bedtime stories. Separate YouTube channel, Notion DB, and Instagram account.
_voice_note: Gigi — child-like, playful ElevenLabs voice (jBpfuIE2acCO8z3wKNLl). Falls back to Google Cloud TTS Aoede (warm female Chirp3-HD voice).
_visual_prompt_mode_note: kids_rhyming = H3 native voice + 3D animation style (no TTS, bright cheerful visuals). cinematic = action/fight scene style. narration = TTS voice + cinematic b-roll.
_script_duration_note: Kids videos are shorter — 1-2 minutes. At 150 WPM: 1 min = ~150 words, 2 min = ~300 words.
_script_style_note: Writing style: kids_rhyming produces singable rhyming scripts for children
_weekly_schedule_note: Kids content performs best in the morning. Schedule at 8 AM IST (2:30 UTC).
